description.narrative:
UN Special Political Missions (SPMs) are crucial for the UN’s efforts in preventative diplomacy, conflict resolution, and post conflict peacebuilding.
The UN International Residual Mechanism for Court Tribunals (IRMCT) is mandated to perform several essential functions previously carried out by the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR) and the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY).
The Organisation for Security Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) Field Mission budget is crucial for the organisation’s operations and support and covers the OSCE Secretariat and Institutions, as well as field operations and activities.
The International Criminal Court (ICC) operates under a budget that is crucial for its functioning and effectiveness. The budget is allocated across several key components, including regular budget for core activities, the Assembly of State Parties activities and specific projects like witness protection and reparations.
